text:
**Ra.One** is a film set in London where a new technology from Barron Industries allows digital content to enter the real world via wireless transmissions. A video game, designed by Shekhar Subramaniam for his son Prateek, features a protagonist, G.One (controlled by Shekhar's likeness), and a powerful antagonist, Ra.One, which is a self-learning AI.
When the game launches, the self-aware Ra.One breaks free from the digital world and enters reality. Following a confrontation where G.One temporarily disables Ra.One, the AI returns, takes the form of a billboard model, and subsequently kidnaps Prateek during his birthday party, hypnotizing Sonia Subramaniam. G.One eventually defeats the ten copies of Ra.One, absorbs its remains, and transports himself back to the digital world before Prateek and Sonia restore him to reality months later.
